g.text: acceptConfirmation(sessionId, toolCallId, eventId, segmentId, result, appender, acceptedAt)
locks Session and exact execution before terminal append.
Interrupt receipts are not linked to the message segment.
A committed stop prevents confirmation accept or claim.
Segment append requires same Session and current OPEN segment.
Exact terminal retries restore original data without new writes.
Terminal commit cancels PENDING decisions in all three tables.
The session and execution IDs bound the update across all segments.
CLAIMED and COMPLETED records keep their original state.
